Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state whether you consent to having this call
recorded.
A: Yes, I consent.
Q: Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?
A: I was driving home from the grocery store in Conroe, Texas. It was early afternoon and I was in the right lane on a
two-lane road heading toward my neighborhood.
Q: Walk me through what happened right before impact.
A: A car came over into my lane from the opposite direction. I tried to steer right, but it was too late. The front ends
met, though not very hard. It felt more like a jolt than a crash.
Q: What was your speed at the time?
A: I'd guess around twenty-five miles an hour. Traffic was light and I wasn't in a hurry.
Q: Were the airbags deployed, and did you need to be taken from the scene?
A: No airbags went off. I got out on my own and sat on the curb while we waited for the officer. An ambulance came,
but I declined a ride.
Q: When did you first notice pain or stiffness?
A: Within about an hour I had a stiff neck and a headache. By the next morning my neck was tight and turning my
head to the left hurt quite a bit. My upper back has been sore too.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble sleeping because of the neck pain, and I'd like to be kept informed about the next
steps.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
